metadata.description: Source-grounded software systems, services, events, APIs and deployment architecture

BusinessRule.description: Domain rule supported by observable evidence

containsModule.description: Identifies a build or source module contained in a repository; each modeled module belongs to at most one repository.

definesService.description: Identifies the service defined by a source or build module; this structural declaration does not establish a running deployment.

containsClass.description: Identifies a class or named type declaration contained in a module; each modeled declaration belongs to at most one module.

definesMethod.description: Identifies a method or function declared by a class; this declaration does not establish that the method was executed.

exposesApi.description: Identifies an API endpoint exposed by a service contract or implementation; availability at runtime requires separate observation evidence.

callsService.description: Records a service-to-service call dependency supported by the cited source; static code or configuration does not establish that a call occurred at runtime.

publishes.description: Identifies an event type a service is declared or observed to publish; the cited evidence must distinguish declaration from actual emission.

carriedBy.description: Identifies a broker topic used to carry an event type; a routing declaration does not establish delivery of a particular event instance.

consumes.description: Identifies an event type a service is declared or observed to consume; the cited evidence must distinguish subscription or code from actual processing.

writesTable.description: Records a declared or observed write dependency from a service to a table or collection; actual writes require observation evidence.

implementsRule.description: Claims that a service implements the target business rule; the relationship requires supporting evidence and does not itself verify correctness.

changesConfig.description: Identifies a configuration entry changed by a commit, supported by revision or diff evidence; the change need not be deployed.

configures.description: Associates a configuration entry with a service whose behavior it configures; the entry alone does not establish the effective runtime value.

deploys.description: Identifies a service targeted by a deployment record; deployment intent or configuration alone does not prove that the service version ran successfully.
